summary: Frontend testing of Practice Exam 3 feature - all 15 test cases passed. The exam has 30 questions in 5 blocks with SPSS output scenarios, answer shuffling, and complete quiz flow.
passed_tests: Practice Exams card appears at bottom of chapter list with 'Practice' badge and 'Exam 3' subtitle (data-testid='chapter-practice')
Clicking Practice Exams card navigates to Practice Exam 3 landing page with exam description (30 questions, Chapters 12-13, two-tailed NHT)
Clicking 'Start Exam' button (pe3-start-btn) begins the exam with question 01 and SPSS scenario table above it
SPSS scenario for Q01-06 shows therapy Descriptives and ANOVA tables with correct data (F=13.16, Sig=.000) - data-testid='spss-scenario-therapy'
Can select an answer and submit it - feedback shows correct/incorrect with explanation (green/red highlighting)
Previous (pe3-prev-btn) and Next (pe3-next-btn) navigation work through all 30 questions
Progress bar updates correctly as questions are navigated (Question X of 30)
When a new SPSS block starts (Q07), the scenario changes to show study methods data with Tukey HSD post hoc table (spss-scenario-study)
Q12-19 show the Caffeine×Sleep two-factor ANOVA SPSS output (spss-scenario-caffeine) with interaction term
Q20-25 show the Gender×Exercise two-factor ANOVA SPSS output (spss-scenario-gender)
Q26-30 (standalone conceptual questions) show NO SPSS scenario above them - verified all 4 scenario test IDs are absent
After answering all 30 questions and clicking Finish Exam, results page shows percentage and correct count (X out of 30 correct)
Back to Chapters button works from: landing page (pe3-back-btn), during exam (pe3-quiz-back-btn), and results page (pe3-results-home)
Retry button (pe3-results-retry) on results page restarts the exam - returns to landing page
Answer options are randomized (shuffled) for each attempt - verified by comparing option order across 3 attempts
critical_code_review_comments: PracticeExam3.jsx is well-structured with clear separation of SPSS scenario components (ScenarioTherapy, ScenarioStudyMethods, ScenarioCaffeineSleep, ScenarioGenderExercise)
shuffleOptions function correctly randomizes answer options while tracking correct answer index
useMemo hook properly memoizes shuffled questions to prevent re-shuffling during the exam
All 30 questions have proper scenarioKey mapping (therapy: Q1-6, studyMethods: Q7-11, caffeineSleep: Q12-19, genderExercise: Q20-25, none: Q26-30)
Quiz state management (started, currentIdx, selectedAnswer, isSubmitted, answeredQuestions, showResults) is clean and functional

All required data-testid attributes are present for testing: pe3-back-btn, pe3-start-btn, pe3-question-text, pe3-option-a/b/c/d, pe3-submit-btn, pe3-next-btn, pe3-prev-btn, pe3-results-home, pe3-results-retry, pe3-quiz-back-btn, spss-scenario-therapy/study/caffeine/gender
App.js correctly routes 'practiceExam3' state to PracticeExam3 component
chaptersData.js correctly defines Practice Exams entry with isPracticeExam flag
seed_data_creation: None needed - all exam questions and SPSS data are in PracticeExam3.jsx
context_for_next_testing_agent: Practice Exam 3 feature fully tested and working.
